sources.states: 10-20% once per week (best), or 25%+ once per month
sources.quote: changing 10-20% of your aquarium water once per week (best)

freshwater_pct_per_week.note: Ours is 20-25 %; stated range 10-20 % touches our low end only (agrees at 20). Same page says 10-20% every 2 weeks is also suggested, i.e. lower. Midpoint of ours used as 22.5.

planted_pct_per_week.note: gcshop-sg.com table gives lightly stocked planted tank 20-30% every 1-2 weeks (supports 25% per 1-2 wk, weekly-equivalent 10-30%), but the table cells are not one contiguous quote so not attached. American Aquarium page says well-planted tanks often can go longer than weekly.

sources.states: 10% weekly, or 20% every other week (5-10% per week equivalent)
sources.quote: A 10% weekly water change is the best schedule, for a 40 gallon tank that means removing 5 gallons of water

saltwater_pct_per_week.note: 10% weekly or 20% every other week = 10 %/week equivalent; ours 15 is 50 % higher. Hobby range 10-20% every 1-2 wk; consider 10.
